LAW_BASIS: [039]-[041] require expected-version CAS and monotonic STATE_VERSION on every authoritative fence mutation.
[046] permits USER_STOP to preempt any non-terminal global transition.
[080] defines MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH as the global bulk-invalidation generation.
[121]-[123] make ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH lease/membership authority bindings whose changes stale old authority.
[133] binds integration intents to ENGINEERING_EPOCH and owner membership generation/epoch.
[164]-[168] require USER_STOP to be immediate/preemptive while preserving durable integration/Git truth.

AUTHORITY_MODEL.STOP_LINEARIZATION_POINT: The single successful expected-version Bootstrap Fence or Mission Fence CAS that enters STOPPING and atomically closes authority gates. All authority decisions are ordered around this CAS.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.POST_STOP_PHYSICAL_ARTIFACT_RULE: A durable worker-branch write may physically appear after STOP if an already-running actor executes from stale local state. Such a write has zero canonical mission authority, is a stale noncanonical worker artifact under the stale-authority rules, must be preserved as evidence, and must never create integration-ready or ACTIVE_INTEGRATION authority.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.CANONICAL_SAFETY_GOAL: No mutation/integration authority survives the STOP linearization point, even if stale noncanonical bytes later appear on an isolated worker branch.

ENTRY_CAS: Preserve legacy freeze/drain evidence and any ambiguous external truth.
PRE_MISSION_FENCE_STOP.FINAL_STATE: STOPPED or STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED when external authority state cannot be proven.
FORBIDDEN: Mission Fence creation after STOP linearizes.
Legacy drain advancement as mission progress.

PRECONDITIONS: USER_STOP may preempt any non-terminal TRANSITION_KIND and does not wait for routine work.
ATOMIC_WRITES: Increment TRANSITION_GENERATION exactly once for the stop transition.
Preserve the preempted transition identity and durable evidence instead of erasing it.
MISSION_FENCE_STOP_ENTRY_CAS.RATIONALE: At the STOP CAS, every pre-stop lease becomes stale through ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH changes, old ACTIVE memberships lose mutation authority, and all not-yet-active integration intents become stale through their epoch bindings.

POST_STOP_ADMISSION_RULES: No new normal work/task/resource lease may be granted.
No stale lease may be renewed into mutation eligibility.
No queued integration intent created before STOP may be reserved as ACTIVE_INTEGRATION after STOP.
No new integration intent may be created as authorized mission progress.
Read-only reconciliation/audit may continue only to preserve truth and determine STOPPED versus STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
WORKER_RACE_RULE: A worker that revalidated [220] before STOP and writes after the STOP linearization point acts on a stale ENGINEERING_EPOCH/MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH and therefore has no mutation authority.
The stale worker branch may be retained for forensic evidence but is noncanonical and must be excluded from verified integrated progress.
Any integration-ready record derived from that stale write is invalid.
A later mission generation may not inherit the stale write implicitly; reuse requires an explicit fresh task/evidence/review path under the new authority.
ACTIVE_INTEGRATION_STOP_RULE: USER_STOP never nulls or overwrites ACTIVE_INTEGRATION merely to make the state look stopped.
If ACTIVE_INTEGRATION is before Git ref mutation and commit status is provably NOT_COMMITTED, stop leaves target unchanged and records the reservation as preempted/stale.
If Git ref may have moved or state is REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS/COMMITTED_PENDING_VERIFICATION/ambiguous, reconcile actual Git truth using [142]-[145].
If reconciliation cannot prove a safe terminal state, final stop state is STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
No unrelated integration is admitted during reconciliation.
LOCAL_VALIDATOR_HARDENING: Before starting each concrete mutation operation, reread authoritative fence state and require MISSION_STATUS not STOPPING/STOPPED, MUTATION_GATE=OPEN, and the lease ENGINEERING_EPOCH/MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH to equal the fence values.
This local check reduces stale physical writes but is not the authority linearization mechanism; the STOP CAS epoch invalidation is authoritative.
Never claim a physical no-write guarantee unless the actual mutation sink provides an atomic fence check.
STOP_COMPLETION: After preserving/reconciling ACTIVE_INTEGRATION and external Git truth, transition by expected-version CAS to MISSION_STATUS=STOPPED or STOPPED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
Do not reset ENGINEERING_EPOCH, MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, TRANSITION_GENERATION, or STATE_VERSION.
Do not erase preempted transition identity, integration result, recovery evidence, or stale-worker evidence.
IDEMPOTENCY: A repeated USER_STOP observed after STOPPING/STOPPED does not create new mutation authority and must not decrement/reset any generation.
If a second STOP request needs recording, append evidence/message records without reopening gates.
TORTURE_TESTS_REQUIRED: Worker revalidates immediately before STOP CAS, then attempts a worker-branch write after STOP.
Queued integration intent races STOP entry.
Task/resource lease renewal races STOP entry.
USER_STOP during each ACTIVE_INTEGRATION phase including REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS.
Repeated USER_STOP during STOPPING and after STOPPED.
Stale worker artifact exists after STOP and an integration queue scanner attempts to admit it.
PASS_CRITERIA: The STOP entry CAS atomically closes all three gates and increments ENGINEERING_EPOCH and MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH.
Every pre-stop lease/membership is provably stale after the CAS.
Every pre-stop not-yet-active integration intent is rejected after the CAS.
ACTIVE_INTEGRATION/Git truth is preserved and reconciled rather than erased.
Any post-stop stale worker artifact remains noncanonical and cannot become integrated authority.
No test or evidence claims physical sink-level no-write atomicity unless actually executed against such a sink.
STRONGER_GUARANTEE_BOUNDARY: If TERMINAL semantics are interpreted to require that no physical worker-branch Git ref or commit object can be created after the STOP linearization point, V16-RC1.3 does not define a sink-level atomic primitive coupling Mission Fence CAS to worker Git mutation. That stronger property requires explicit successor-law semantics and/or a mutation sink enforcing the fence atomically.
